caveats: Six of the ten records came from scraper-style directories (Birdeye, Cylex, bestprosintown) rather than the businesses' own sites; a New Brunswick 'address' in those sources often means service area or scraped location, not a shopfront.
Only two businesses (New Jersey Mechanical Contractors, Apollo Sewer & Plumbing) had both a working website and a claimed Google profile; the rest are dormant listings or have a broken site.
Google Maps in an unauthenticated browser sometimes hides review counts; where the count was not displayed I said so rather than estimate.
Review quotes are summarised in a few words, not reproduced.
data_gaps: BuildZoom, BBB and Cylex returned HTTP 403 to both fetch and browser requests, so licence-status and BBB-rating claims for Ster Plumbing, PrimeVent and Apollo rely on search-result summaries, not pages I read.
Brunswick Plumbing: the Birdeye profile says the business claimed it with a 5.0/1 review, while the Google listing is unclaimed with zero reviews - the two disagree and I could not reconcile them.
New Jersey Mechanical Contractors: the Google review count was not rendered in the limited Maps view; only the 5.0 rating is confirmed.
No phone number could be verified for Brunswick Plumbing, Airdex's New Brunswick listing, or Greyson Furnace Repair (none published anywhere I could open).
S&D Maintenance's domain returns 404 for every path tried; I could not tell whether it once worked or is a parked placeholder.
No Google Business Profile could be opened for Ster Plumbing, PrimeVent, Greyson Furnace Repair or Precision Plumbing - all four appear to be directory-only records.
